criteria_results.text: Agents controls are consolidated into a usable top-right overflow menu while search remains persistent.
criteria_results.notes: Search and menu actions worked, but the physical iPhone clipped the bottom of the menu and offered no way to scroll to the hidden actions.

criteria_results.text: Owner-matched desktop human sessions appear in Chats while system work remains in Activity.
criteria_results.notes: Mobile-originated sessions appeared in Chats, while desktop-originated human sessions remained in Activity. Scheduled tasks and background loops were classified correctly.

criteria_results.text: Opening a real existing chat remains responsive and recoverable when its transcript is large.
criteria_results.notes: A real transcript was 8.95 MB and exceeded the gateway's 8 MB response cap. Mobile requested the full transcript twice during open, received HTTP 502, then became black and unresponsive after the error was dismissed.

criteria_results.text: Review Queue and Gallery show paired-Mac data rather than false empty states.
criteria_results.notes: Gallery listed real items. Playback/rendering is a future enhancement and listing is accepted for this smoke.

criteria_results.text: Mobile catalogs provide usable organization and truthful provider/model information.
criteria_results.notes: Skills and Providers & Models worked. Additional category organization for Skills and Agent Profiles remains a product follow-up, not a blocker for this corrective smoke.

criteria_results.text: Mobile-created sessions apply profile MCP, tool, and skill scope on the first turn.
criteria_results.notes: The physical-device retest indicated the selected profile scope now applies to mobile-originated chats.

failure_output: Physical iPhone: overflow actions clipped without scrolling; desktop human sessions stayed in Activity; opening a real 8.95 MB transcript returned HTTP 502 and dismissing the error led to a black frozen screen.
suggested_follow_up: Keep issue #1285 as the owning follow-up. Add native-height menu coverage, a real historical-session discovery contract, and a large-transcript open/recovery contract that exercises the gateway response limit and prevents duplicate full-history fetches.
